settings.heading: Who is the Orenda Mid-Life Balance Bundle for?
settings.row_content:
You've been here before, that moment when you realize something has shifted. Not dramatically, not all at once, but enough that you notice. Your energy requires more effort to find. Sleep doesn't restore you the way it used to. Your thinking feels less sharp on certain days. Your body is working harder to maintain a balance that used to come naturally, and no one around you seems to be talking about why.

That's changing. Women are finally having this conversation, with their friends, with their healthcare providers, with themselves. And what's becoming clear is that the midlife transition isn't just a hormonal event. It's a convergence. Sleep, energy, immunity, cognitive clarity, mood, and hormonal balance all shift at once, across multiple systems, often without much warning and sometimes without much support.

Most approaches address one piece of that at a time. This bundle was built around the whole picture.

Orenda O-Tropin® supports the neuroendocrine communication pathway that governs energy, recovery, and the body's hormonal signaling, the system that coordinates how every other system responds.* Orenda Immune + Detox® supports immune coordination and the daily detoxification of the hormonal and environmental burden that accumulates during this transition, because a body managing that burden is an immune system already under demand.* Orenda Women's® provides the vitamins, minerals, and exclusive O'Harmony botanical blend developed specifically to support hormonal balance and daily vitality for women navigating midlife and beyond.*

Three products. Three entry points into the same transition. Each addresses what the others don't, and together they cover what most single supplements never reach.

This bundle is for the woman who has been paying attention to her health, doing the right things, and is ready for something that was actually built for where she is right now. Not a quick fix. Not a promise. A foundation built for this specific chapter of her life.

settings.heading: What is calcium d-glucarate, and why is it in Orenda Immune + Detox®?
settings.row_content:
Calcium d-glucarate supports glucuronidation, the liver's primary detoxification pathway. Glucuronidation works by binding toxins and excess hormones to glucuronic acid, making them water-soluble so the body can clear them through normal elimination. It's one of the most important and most overlooked detoxification processes the body runs every day.

The reason supplementing with calcium d-glucarate matters is what happens without adequate support. An enzyme produced by certain gut bacteria, called beta-glucuronidase, can interfere with glucuronidation, essentially splitting the bond between processed toxins and the compounds that carry them out of the body. When that happens, those toxins are reabsorbed into circulation rather than eliminated, creating a recycling loop that adds to the body's overall toxic burden over time.

Calcium d-glucarate helps inhibit beta-glucuronidase activity, keeping that recycling loop from running and supporting more complete toxin clearance.* It also supports healthy hormone metabolism, helping the body clear excess estrogen and environmental estrogen mimickers that accumulate through diet, environment, and natural hormonal shifts.* This is particularly relevant for adults navigating midlife hormonal changes, when the body's natural detox channels are under greater demand.*

Research also suggests that calcium d-glucarate supports a balanced inflammatory response, an important consideration given the close connection between immune function and inflammation.* When the body's detoxification pathways are working well, the immune system is better positioned to respond appropriately rather than remaining in a state of ongoing activation.*

This is why detoxification belongs in an immune formula. A body managing a high toxic burden is an immune system already working overtime, and calcium d-glucarate addresses that burden directly, every day.*

settings.heading: What does organic beta-1,3 glucan do, and why is it in this formula?
settings.row_content:
Beta-1,3 glucan from organic oat bran is a soluble fiber that interacts with immune cell receptors throughout the body, specifically on macrophages, neutrophils, and natural killer cells, supporting the immune system's natural, everyday defense function.* These are the frontline cells of the innate immune response, and beta-1,3 glucan is one of the most well-studied ingredients for supporting their activity.*

Gut health and immune health are more closely connected than most people realize. Roughly 70% of the immune system resides in the gut, which is why it matters that beta-1,3 glucan also functions as a prebiotic fiber, nourishing the beneficial bacteria in the digestive system that the immune system depends on.* Supporting the gut microbiome is supporting immune health from the inside out.*

Beta-1,3 glucan from oat bran has also been studied for its role in supporting healthy cholesterol levels already within the normal range and contributing to cardiovascular well-being*, a benefit backed by decades of published research. Sourced from organic oat bran rather than mushrooms, it's clean, non-GMO, and naturally gluten-free.

settings.heading: Why does Orenda Women's® use Methylcobalamin instead of standard vitamin B-12?
settings.row_content:
Most daily multivitamins use cyanocobalamin, the synthetic form of vitamin B-12 that has been the standard in supplements for decades. Cyanocobalamin works for many people, but it must be converted by the body before it can be used in its active form. For some people, this conversion process is less efficient than it should be,* which means the B-12 in their supplement may not be delivering its full potential benefit.

Methylcobalamin is the active form of vitamin B-12, already in the state the body uses directly, without requiring conversion.* This makes it more bioavailable and more readily utilized than standard cyanocobalamin for a broader range of people.* It is the form increasingly recommended by health practitioners who work with patients on nutritional optimization, energy metabolism support, and overall neurological wellness.

For Orenda Women's®, the decision to use Methylcobalamin rather than standard cyanocobalamin reflects the same formulation philosophy behind BioFolate® methylated folate, choosing the active form the body can actually use rather than the form that is simply most common or least expensive. Together, Methylcobalamin and BioFolate® represent a meaningful upgrade in the B-vitamin profile of Orenda Women's® that most standard multivitamins simply don't provide.

settings.heading: What is PharmaGABA® and how does it work?
settings.row_content:
GABA — gamma-aminobutyric acid — is a neurotransmitter the body produces naturally. It plays a key role in calming nervous system activity, supporting relaxation, and contributing to the quality of rest the body needs for its natural overnight recovery processes.*

Most GABA supplements use a synthetic form that research suggests may not cross the blood-brain barrier effectively, limiting how much benefit actually reaches the nervous system. PharmaGABA® is different. It is produced through a natural fermentation process using Lactobacillus hilgardii, the same beneficial bacteria used in traditional food fermentation, resulting in a form of GABA that research suggests is more readily recognized and utilized by the body.*

In O-Tropin®, PharmaGABA® supports relaxation and calm nervous system activity,* and contributes to restorative sleep when experiencing occasional sleeplessness.* It is produced without artificial ingredients or fillers, and carries a clean safety profile backed by published research.

For adults navigating the sleep and stress challenges that often accompany midlife, PharmaGABA® is one of the most credible and well-researched natural support ingredients available.*

settings.heading: What does CoQ10 do, and why is it in this formula?
settings.row_content:
Coenzyme Q10 — CoQ10 — is a naturally occurring compound found in every cell in the body. Its primary role is supporting the production of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the form of energy the body's cells run on.* CoQ10 is particularly concentrated in the heart, brain, and muscles, the organs and tissues with the highest energy demands.*

The body produces CoQ10 naturally, but that production tends to decline with age, a shift that can affect energy availability at the cellular level.* Supplementing with CoQ10 supports the body's natural energy production processes and contributes to cardiovascular and overall cellular well-being.*

Both Orenda Active® and Orenda Women's® include CoQ10 as part of a formulation built around ingredient depth rather than minimum effective doses. For adults navigating midlife and beyond, maintaining adequate CoQ10 levels is one of the more well-supported strategies for supporting sustained energy and cellular health.*

settings.heading: Benefits of Alpha-GPC
settings.row_content:
Hey there, wellness seekers! Let's shine the spotlight on Alpha-GPC, a standout ingredient that's making waves in the world of wellness. Alpha-GPC (or alpha-glyceryl phosphorylcholine if you want to be fancy) is a choline-rich compound that's brimming with benefits for our bodies and brains.

Now, I hear you thinking, "But what on earth is choline?“, let's break it down. Choline is an essential micronutrient that plays a crucial role in our body's everyday functions. It's the mastermind behind a crucial neurotransmitter, acetylcholine, which helps our nerves chat with each other, manages muscle contraction, and supports optimal brain function.*

While choline is naturally produced by our bodies, absorption can sometimes be tricky. Enter Alpha-GPC! Alpha-GPC is like choline's VIP pass to your brain. Letting it cruise past the body's protective blood-brain barrier and deliver its nutrient-rich benefits straight to your brain cells. It's the secret sauce to supporting your brain's acetylcholine levels, helping support memory, attention, and long-term brain health.

But Alpha-GPC isn't just a one-trick pony. It also supports muscle strength, offering a double dose of benefits for both body and mind. So, whether you're tackling a busy workday, pushing through an intense workout, or simply looking to support your overall cognitive function, Alpha-GPC is here to support your wellness journey.

settings.heading: Why does Orenda Women's® use BioFolate® methylated folate instead of folic acid?
settings.row_content:
Most daily multivitamins use folic acid, the synthetic form of folate that has been the standard in supplements for decades. Folic acid works for many people, but for a meaningful portion of the population it presents a bioavailability challenge. The body needs to convert folic acid into its active form before it can be used, and for those with certain common genetic variations this conversion process is less efficient than it should be.*

BioFolate® is the methylated form of folate, already in the active state the body uses directly, without requiring conversion.* This makes it more bioavailable and more readily utilized than standard folic acid for a broader range of people.* It is the form increasingly recommended by health practitioners who work with patients on nutritional optimization, methylation support, and overall wellness.

For Orenda Women's®, the decision to use BioFolate® rather than standard folic acid reflects the same formulation philosophy behind every ingredient in the formula, choosing the form that the body can actually use rather than the form that is simply most common or least expensive. It is one of the details that separates a purposeful women's multivitamin from a standard one.

settings.heading: Benefits of Mucuna Pruriens
settings.row_content:
Introducing Mucuna Pruriens extract, often dubbed as the "Velvet Bean," this little legume is a treasure trove of well-being and vitality! Originating from the lush regions of Africa and tropical Asia, it has been celebrated for centuries in traditional Ayurvedic practices, not just for its unique velvet-like texture, but for its impressive health benefits.

Here's the secret—Mucuna Pruriens is rich in L-DOPA, a naturally occurring amino acid that transforms into dopamine in your body. Now, dopamine isn't just any molecule, it's the superstar neurotransmitter that plays a significant role in mood, pleasure, and overall brain health.

Think of Mucuna Pruriens as your personal 'mood-elevator'. Its potential mood-boosting properties can make a real difference on those days when you could use a little extra sunshine! It's not just about feeling good; it's about enhancing your cognitive functions too. With its support to dopamine production, Mucuna Pruriens might just give you that much-needed support for enhancing focus and memory.*

Stress? We've all been there. This wonderful extract has also been traditionally used to manage stress. Imagine it as your calm anchor in the whirlwind of life, helping you stay composed amidst the chaos. And when the day draws to a close, and your racing mind struggles to switch off, Mucuna Pruriens might lend a hand, supporting restful sleep when you experience occasional sleeplessness.

But the magic doesn't stop there! Mucuna Pruriens is packed with antioxidants - your body's personal defense squad against free radicals. These warriors work tirelessly, promoting overall well-being and healthy aging.

Embrace the journey to wellness with Mucuna Pruriens extract. Remember, just like a seed doesn't sprout overnight, give your body time to adjust and embrace the remarkable benefits this gem of nature has to offer. Trust the process and feel the difference!

settings.heading: Benefits of Alpha-lipoic Acid (ALA)
settings.row_content:
Alpha-lipoic Acid, or ALA for short, is a naturally occurring compound that doubles as a coenzyme in our bodies. What makes ALA stand out is its ability to dissolve both in water and fat, allowing it to function across various parts of cells and tissues.

But its potential health benefits are where things get truly exciting. ALA is a formidable antioxidant, standing guard to protect your cells from the havoc that free radicals can cause.* If maintaining your blood sugar levels within a healthy range is a priority, ALA might be your ally. It's been suggested that it can improve how your body responds to insulin.*

When it comes to brain health, ALA might offer protection by supporting our precious brain cells.*

And let's not forget about heart health. ALA may contribute to a healthier heart by reducing blood pressure, improving cholesterol levels, and supporting the health and function of your blood vessels.*

If you're on a journey towards better weight management, ALA could potentially assist with weight loss and support your metabolic function.*

Remember, these are just a few of the potential health benefits of ALA. As with all supplements, individual results may vary, and it's always recommended to consult with your healthcare professional. With ALA in its arsenal, Orenda Women's® is ready to support you in your journey toward better health.

settings.heading: Benefits of Moomiyo extract
settings.row_content:
Let me share a little secret with you - often referred to as "nature's black gold", it's called Moomiyo extract, also known as Shilajit. It has been a well-guarded secret in wellness circles for centuries. Originating from the high-altitude mountains of Central Asia, this rare and unique substance is packed with bioactive components, which include humic acids and trace minerals, it's like nature's very own multi-mineral complex!

You see, in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, they've recognized the power of Moomiyo for centuries. It's celebrated for supporting a well-functioning immune system, and its adaptogenic properties when it comes to supporting your body manage stress.* And it doesn’t stop there! It supports fostering vitality and vigor and has revitalizing and rejuvenating properties.* With O-Tropin, we're bringing this mountain treasure right to you.

Harnessing the power of Moomiyo in our Orenda O-Tropin®, we help to energize your day, and support your overall vitality, and your body's natural defense system.* It's like getting a mountain's worth of wellness in every spray of O-Tropin. So, whether you're hiking up your own life's mountains or just need that daily pick-me-up, Moomiyo is here to lend a helping hand! Remember, wellness isn't a peak to be conquered, but a journey, and Moomiyo is your trusty companion on this beautiful path.

settings.heading: Why include N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine (NAC)?
settings.row_content:
N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine (NAC) is a powerful antioxidant that can help protect your body from damage caused by free radicals. It is also a precursor to glutathione, which is another important antioxidant. NAC has been shown to have a number of health benefits, including:

Improved respiratory health: NAC can help to break up mucus in the lungs, which can make it easier to cough it up. It can also help to reduce inflammation in the lungs, which can make it easier to breathe.

Improved heart health: NAC can help lower blood pressure and improve cholesterol levels. It may also help support heart health by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

  • Improved immune function: NAC is a supplement that is made from the amino acid cysteine. It has been shown to have a number of health benefits, including improving immune function. NAC can help to increase the production of white blood cells, which are important for fighting off infection. It can also help to reduce inflammation, which can help the body to heal from infection.
  • NAC may help improve athletic performance: NAC may help improve athletic performance by increasing oxygen delivery to the muscles and reducing inflammation.

settings.heading: Should I take the Orenda Mid-Life Balance Bundle if I am on medication?
settings.row_content:
Orenda O-Tropin®, Orenda Immune + Detox®, and Orenda Women's® are each formulated with high-quality, well-researched ingredients and are generally well-tolerated.* That said, if you are currently under medical care or taking any medications, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any new supplement to your routine.

This is especially relevant during the midlife transition, when many women are navigating changes in their health and medications alongside the natural shifts this chapter brings. Your healthcare provider understands your full health picture and is the right person to make that call with you.
